summary: Serinity Young was a scholar of Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and religious studies. She earned her Ph.D. from Columbia University in 1990 under Alex Wayman and Vidya Dehejia, later working at the American Museum of Natural History and Southern Methodist University.
Sesso Oda was a Buddhist studies figure who studied under and succeeded Zuigan Goto. He taught Gary Snyder and Soko Morinaga.

Seth Segall is a scholar in Buddhist studies and philosophy who earned his PhD from Southern Illinois University Carbondale in 1977. He held posts at Yale School of Medicine (1981–2017), Waterbury Hospital, and Purchase College, SUNY (2012–2017).
Seton Uhlhorn is an Indologist who served as a PhD candidate and Instructional Fellow in South Asian Studies at Harvard University (attested 2020, 2026).

Seung-yeon Lee works in Buddhist studies and history/archaeology. Lee studied under doctoral supervisor Lee Sang-hae and held posts at the Gyeonggi Institute of Cultural Properties and Sungkyunkwan University.

Seunghak Koh specializes in Buddhist studies, completing a Ph.D. at UCLA (2003–2011) under Robert E. Buswell Jr. He held positions at Geumgang University (2017–2025) and became Associate Professor at Seoul National University in 2025.

Seungsahn Haengwon was a Buddhist figure who studied at Dongguk University and under teachers including Kobong Sunim, whom he succeeded in 1957. He founded the Kwan Um School of Zen in 1970 and taught numerous students.

Seán McLoughlin works in religious studies and Indology, earning a Ph.D. from the University of Manchester. He was attested in 2005 as a Lecturer in South Asian, Islamic and Religious Studies at the University of Leeds.

Shagun Sinha works in Indology and computational linguistics. Sinha earned a PhD from Jawaharlal Nehru University under doctoral supervisor Girish Nath Jha (attested 2022) and was taught by Shashi Prabha Kumar and Ram Nath Jha, among others.

Shahid Rasheed is an Indologist who studied under Antonia Ruppel and McComas Taylor. Rasheed has held posts at Lahore University of Management Sciences and as Associate Professor of sociology at Forman Christian College (attested 2025).

Shailendra Bhandare is an Indology and history/archaeology specialist who served as Assistant Keeper at the Ashmolean Museum (attested 2006–2022), Fellow at St Cross College (attested 2022), and held posts at the British Museum and Fitzwilliam Museum.
Shailja Singh earned an MBBS from Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College, Aligarh (2019–2025). Working in Indology, Singh was appointed Concurrent Faculty at Jawaharlal Nehru University (attested 2026).

Shaman Hatley is a scholar of Indology and religious studies who earned a PhD at the University of Pennsylvania (~2000–2007) under Harunaga Isaacson. He taught at Concordia University (~2007–2015) and joined the University of Massachusetts Boston in 2015.
Shan Shan Zhao is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a Master of Arts at McMaster University under the supervision of James A. Benn, also studying under Shayne Clarke and Mark Rowe.

Shanshan Jia is an Indology and Tibetology scholar who studied as a doctoral student under Harunaga Isaacson at the University of Hamburg (attested 2015, 2026), where Jia also served as a Wissenschaftliche Projektmitarbeiterin (attested 2026).
Shantanu Nevrekar works in Indology and anthropology, studying as a PhD candidate at Stanford University (2019–2026). In 2026, Nevrekar served as Visiting Faculty at Ashoka University.
Shanti Bhikshu Shastri worked in Buddhist studies and Indology, studying under Friedrich Weller and teaching Wilhelm Rau. Shastri was also on the research staff at Visva-Bharati University.
Shantu Barua specializes in Buddhist studies and studied at Ryukoku University (attested 2015). In 2020, Barua served as Associate Professor at the University of Dhaka.

Shaoyong Ye is a Buddhist studies and Indology scholar who completed doctoral studies at Peking University in 2009 under Qing Duan. Ye served as Associate Professor (attested 2010–2016) and faculty member (attested 2026) at Peking University.
Sharad Deshpande works in philosophy and Indology. He studied at Savitribai Phule Pune University in 1972 and served there as a professor (attested 2026).
